Rashi on Sotah 43a:10:1.english: From "And [the priest] shall approach" until "And [the officers] shall speak" - That is to say, "Hear, O Israel, you draw near, etc.," until "to save you."

Rashi on Sotah 43a:11:1.hebrew: מי האיש - ריבויא הוא, דמצי למיכתב מי אשר בנה, ומדלא כתיב אשר בית בנה, דרוש ביה: בנה מ"מ. והאי דכתיב "בית", למעוטי בית שער, אכסדרה ומרפסת, שהם עשוים לדריסת רגל ולא ראוים לדור בהם:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:11:1.english: What man is there - [This] is an inclusion, for [the verse] could have written "who has built"; and since it did not write "that a house he has built," expound from it: he built [i.e., acquired a house] in any manner. And the reason "a house" is written [is] to exclude a gatehouse, a portico, and a gallery, which are made for foot traffic and are not fit to dwell in.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:11:2.english: A gatehouse - a structure [at] the entrance of the courtyard gate, for the gatekeeper to shelter there.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:13:1.hebrew: ולא חנכו - מדלא כתיב חנך, הוי מיעוטא; חנכו — לזה ולא לאחר, פרט לגוזל בית:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:13:1.english: And has not dedicated it - Since it is not written "dedicated," it is an exclusion: "dedicated it" — for this one and not for another, excluding one who steals a house.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:13:2.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili - [The one] of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:2:1.english: Who mocked - He scorned and subdued it, and did not regard it.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:3:1.hebrew: והלא שבטים מבזים אותו - כדאמרינן באלו הן הנשרפין (סנהדרין דף פב:), לפיכך הוצרך ליחסו שם, פנחס בן אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:3:1.english: But are not the tribes denigrating him - As we say in [the chapter] Eilu Hen HaNisrafin (Sanhedrin 82b); therefore [it] was necessary to trace his lineage there: "Pinehas son of Elazar son of Aaron the priest."

Rashi on Sotah 43a:3:2.english: Two Putis - Since it is not written "Putel" [without the yod].

Rashi on Sotah 43a:4:1.hebrew: בית האוצרות - לאוצר יין, שמן ותבואה:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:4:1.english: A storehouse - For storing wine, oil, and grain.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:4:2.hebrew: ואחד הלוקח - בית בנוי, שהרי אצלו הוא חדש, ובגמרא מרבינן ליה מקרא:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:4:2.english: And one who purchases - a built house, for to him it is new, and in the Gemara we include it from a verse.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:1.hebrew: חמשה אילני מאכל - דבהכי הוי כרם, שתים כנגד שתים ואחת יוצאה זנב:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:1.english: Five fruit trees - For with this [number] it is [considered] a vineyard: two opposite two, and one extending [like] a tail.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:2.hebrew: ואפילו מה' מינין - מצטרפין: כזה (*):(*)
Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:2.english: And even from five species - [They] combine [to constitute the minimum of five trees]. Like this (*):(*)

Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:3.hebrew: חיללו - בשנת הרביעית לנטיעתו, שחלל את הפירות במעות כדרך מעשר שני, ומעלה את המעות לירושלים ואוכלן, כדכתיב (ויקרא י״ט:כ״ד) "קדש הלולים", וגמר "קדש" "קדש" ממעשר:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:5:3.english: Redeemed it [ḥillelo] - In the fourth year of its planting, when he redeems the fruit with money in the manner of the second tithe, and brings the money up to Jerusalem and consumes [what is purchased with] it, as it is written (Leviticus 19:24): "holy, for praise [to the Lord]," and it is derived [via a verbal analogy of] "holy" [and] "holy" from [the second] tithe.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:6:1.hebrew: ה"ג כל אלו שומעין דברי כהן מערכי מלחמה וחוזרין - כמו שומעין דברי מערכי מלחמה של כהן, כלומר שהכהן אומר להן:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:6:1.english: Thus we read: All these hear the words of the priest, the battle arrays, and return - [This is] like: they hear the words of the battle arrays of the priest, that is to say, [those] that the priest says to them.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:1.english: Non-fruit bearing [trees] - For example, cedars and sycamores, which are not fruit trees.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:2.hebrew: והמחזיר גרושתו - ואירסה, אינו חוזר, שאינה חדשה לו; וקרא אאשה חדשה קפיד, כדכתיב: "כי יקח איש אשה חדשה" (דברים כ״ד:ה׳):
Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:2.english: And one who remarries his divorced wife - and betrothed her — he does not return [from the war], because she is not new to him; and the verse is particular about "a new wife," as it is written: "When a man takes a new wife" (Deuteronomy 24:5).

Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:3.hebrew: אלמנה - ואירסה כהן גדול, אינו חוזר בשבילה, דאימעוט מ"ולא לקחה", מדלא כתיב "ולא לקח":
Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:3.english: A widow - [If] a High Priest betrothed her, he does not return on account of her, for [such cases] are excluded from "and has not taken her," since it is not written "and has not taken."

Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:4.hebrew: על מכונו - סתרו ובנאו במדה ראשונה, אינו חוזר, דלאו חדש הוא הואיל ולא חידש להוסיף עליו, ואפילו אצלו אינו חדש, וגרע מהלוקח והיורש:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:4.english: On its foundation - [If] he tore it down and rebuilt it in [its] original dimensions, he does not return, for it is not [considered] new since he did not innovate [anything] to add to it; and even for him it is not new, and he is worse [off] than the buyer and the inheritor.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:5.hebrew: אף הבונה בית לבינים בשרון - מקום הוא ששמו שרון, ואין הקרקע יפה ללבינים, ולא הוי דבר קיימא, שפעמיים צריך לחדשה בשבע שנים:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:7:5.english: Even one who builds a brick house in the Sharon - It is a place whose name is Sharon, and the ground is not suitable for bricks, and it is not something enduring, for one must renew it twice in seven years.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:1.hebrew: ואלו שאין זזין ממקומן - דהנך דלעיל הולכין עד לספר, ושם שומעין דברי כהן, וחוזרין מן המערכה לארץ ישראל, ואינם חוזרין לבתיהם, אלא עוסקין בסיפוק מים ומזון להולכי מלחמה. ואלו אין זזין ממקומן, אפילו ללכת עד הספר ולשוב ע"פ כהן:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:1.english: And these [are the ones] who do not move from their places - For those [mentioned] above go as far as the border, and there they hear the words of the priest, and return from the battlefront to the Land of Israel; and they do not return to their homes, rather they engage in providing water and food for those going to war. But these do not move from their places, even to go as far as the border and return at the word of the priest.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:2.english: One who builds a house and dedicates it - And has not yet lived in it [for] a year.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:3.english: And likewise, one who plants a vineyard and redeems its fruit - And the fourth year has not yet passed upon it in full.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:4.english: He shall be free for his house - For the sake of his house.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:5.hebrew: יהיה - רבויא הוא, הוסיף לך הויה אחרת להיות כזו:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:8:5.english: He shall be - It is an amplification; [the verse] added for you another state of being to be like this one.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:1.hebrew: יכול דברים של עצמן - יכול שהדברים הללו שהם אומרים, "מי האיש אשר בנה וגו'", של עצמן הן, ולא היה כהן אומרן אלא השוטרים:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:1.english: One might [have thought] their own words - One might [have thought] that these words that they say — "What man is there that has built [a new house], etc." (Deuteronomy 20:5) — are their own, and [that] the priest would not say them, but rather the officers.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:2.hebrew: ת"ל ויספו השוטרים - לדבר אל העם ואמרו מי האיש וגו'. ויספו משמע שדבר זה הם מוסיפים משלהם:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:2.english: Therefore [Scripture] states: "And the officers shall speak further" - "to speak unto the people, and they shall say: What man is there, etc." "And they shall add" implies that they are adding this matter on their own.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:3.hebrew: הרי דברים של עצמן אמור - שהדבר זה לבדו הן מוסיפין על של כהן. מדעד השתא, גבי נטע וגבי אירס אשה, לא כתיב "ויספו", והכא כתיב "ויספו" — ש"מ עד הנה דברי כהן, ואת זו הן מוסיפין:
Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:3.english: Their own words are mentioned - For this matter alone they add to [the words] of the priest. Since up to this point, regarding [one who] planted [a vineyard] and regarding [one who] betrothed a woman, "and [the officers] shall speak further" is not written, whereas here "and [the officers] shall speak further" is written — learn from this [that] up to here [were] the words of the priest, and this [one] they add.

Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:4.english: How then do I realize [the meaning of], "And the officers shall speak" - Regarding [one who] built [a house], planted [a vineyard], and betrothed [a wife].

Rashi on Sotah 43a:9:5.english: The verse is speaking of the words of the [priest] anointed for war - That the priest says [them] and the officers make them heard.
